name: Garlic & Sage Chicken Thighs with Maple Roasted Acorn Squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F and position rack in the centre.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, mix together the minced garlic, olive oil, sage, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken and lemon slices to bowl; toss to coat. Set aside.
Heat a saucepan over medium heat. Add oil, maple syrup, chill powder, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 2-3 minutes while you prepare the squash.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
⅛ tsp chili powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and halve squash lengthwise. Scoop out the seeds and cut crosswise into ¼ inch thick slices.
Lightly coat a baking sheet with olive oil.
Add squash slices to baking sheet and pour the maple mixture over top. Toss to coat and arrange slices in a single layer.
Place chicken and lemon slices on top of squash. Place in the oven and roast until squash is tender and chicken is cooked though, 12-15 minutes.
Serve chicken thighs with squash on the side. Enjoy!
